292	func (m searchModel) updateBrowseMode(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) { //nolint:ireturn // bubbletea pattern
293		pageLen := len(m.pageResults())
294		switch msg.String() {
295		case "q", "ctrl+c", tuiEscKey, "h":
296			return m, tea.Quit
297		case "up", "k":
298			if m.cursor > 0 {
299				m.cursor--
300				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
301			}
302		case "down", "j":
303			if m.cursor < pageLen-1 {
304				m.cursor++
305				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
306			}
307		case "home", "g":
308			m.page = 0
309			m.cursor = 0
310			m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
311			m.browseVP.GotoTop()
312		case "end", "G":
313			if len(m.results) > 0 {
314				lastLoaded := len(m.results) - 1
315				m.page = min(lastLoaded/resultsPerPage, m.totalPages()-1)
316				if pageLen := len(m.pageResults()); pageLen > 0 {
317					m.cursor = pageLen - 1
318				}
319				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
320				m.browseVP.GotoBottom()
321			}
322		case "n", "right":
323			if m.page < m.totalPages()-1 {
324				m.page++
325				m.cursor = 0
326				m.browseVP.GotoTop()
327				// Fetch next API page if we've scrolled past loaded results
328				start := m.page * resultsPerPage
329				if start >= len(m.results) && !m.fetchingMore {
330					m.fetchingMore = true
331					m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
332					return m, fetchMoreResults(m.searchCfg, m.apiPage+1)
333				}
334				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
335			}
336		case "p", "left":
337			if m.page > 0 {
338				m.page--
339				m.cursor = 0
340				m.browseVP.GotoTop()
341				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
342			}
343		case "enter":
344			if r := m.selectedResult(); r != nil {
345				m.mode = modeDetail
346				content := m.renderDetailContent(*r, m.width, true)
347				m.detailVP = viewport.New(m.width, max(m.height-2, 1))
348				m.detailVP.SetContent(content)
349				return m, nil
350			}
351		case "/":
352			m.mode = modeSearch
353			m.input.Focus()
354			return m, m.input.Cursor.SetMode(cursor.CursorBlink)
355		default:
356			// Forward unhandled keys (pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d/g/G/etc.) to viewport for scrolling
357			var cmd tea.Cmd
358			m.browseVP, cmd = m.browseVP.Update(msg)
359			return m, cmd
360		}
361		return m, nil
362	}

547	// renderDetailContent builds the text content for a checkpoint detail (no border/card chrome).
548	func (m searchModel) renderDetailContent(r search.Result, contentWidth int, showSections bool) string {
549		const labelWidth = 12
550		// Available width for field values: content width minus label minus space.
551		valueWidth := contentWidth - labelWidth - 1
552		if valueWidth < 20 {
553			valueWidth = 0 // disable wrapping on very narrow terminals
554		}
555	
556		var content strings.Builder
557	
558		content.WriteString(m.styles.render(m.styles.detailTitle, "Checkpoint Detail"))
559		content.WriteString("\n")
560	
561		formatLabel := func(label string) string {
562			return m.styles.render(m.styles.label, fmt.Sprintf("%-*s", labelWidth, label+":"))
563		}
564	
565		writeField := func(label, value string) {
566			content.WriteString(formatLabel(label) + " " + value + "\n")
567		}
568	
569		// writeWrappedField word-wraps a long value, indenting continuation lines to align with the value column.
570		writeWrappedField := func(label, value string) {
571			if valueWidth == 0 || len(value) <= valueWidth {
572				writeField(label, value)
573				return
574			}
575			indent := strings.Repeat(" ", labelWidth+1) // align with value column
576			wrapped := wrapText(value, valueWidth)
577			lines := strings.Split(wrapped, "\n")
578			content.WriteString(formatLabel(label) + " " + lines[0] + "\n")
579			for _, line := range lines[1:] {
580				content.WriteString(indent + line + "\n")
581			}
582		}
583	
584		writeSection := func(title string) {
585			if showSections {
586				content.WriteString("\n" + m.styles.render(m.styles.detailTitle, title) + "\n")
587			} else {
588				content.WriteString("\n")
589			}
590		}
591	
592		// ── OVERVIEW ──
593		writeSection("OVERVIEW")
594		writeField("ID", r.Data.ID)
595		writeWrappedField("Prompt", stringutil.CollapseWhitespace(r.Data.Prompt))
596		matchType := r.Meta.MatchType
597		if r.Meta.Score > 0 {
598			matchType += " " + m.styles.render(m.styles.dim, fmt.Sprintf("(score: %.3f)", r.Meta.Score))
599		}
600		writeField("Match", matchType)
601	
602		// ── SOURCE ──
603		writeSection("SOURCE")
604		writeWrappedField("Commit", formatCommit(r.Data.CommitSHA, r.Data.CommitMessage))
605		writeField("Branch", r.Data.Branch)
606		writeField("Repo", r.Data.Org+"/"+r.Data.Repo)
607		authorStr := r.Data.Author
608		if r.Data.AuthorUsername != nil && *r.Data.AuthorUsername != "" {
609			authorStr = *r.Data.AuthorUsername + " " + m.styles.render(m.styles.dim, "("+r.Data.Author+")")
610		}
611		writeField("Author", authorStr)
612		createdStr := formatDetailCreatedAt(r.Data.CreatedAt, m.styles)
613		writeField("Created", createdStr)
614	
615		// ── SNIPPET ──
616		if r.Meta.Snippet != "" {
617			writeSection("SNIPPET")
618			switch {
619			case showSections:
620				content.WriteString(renderSnippetMarkdown(r.Meta.Snippet, contentWidth, m.darkBg) + "\n")
621			case valueWidth > 0:
622				content.WriteString(wrapText(r.Meta.Snippet, contentWidth) + "\n")
623			default:
624				content.WriteString(r.Meta.Snippet + "\n")
625			}
626		}
627	
628		// ── FILES ──
629		if len(r.Data.FilesTouched) > 0 {
630			content.WriteString("\n")
631			if showSections {
632				content.WriteString(m.styles.render(m.styles.detailTitle, "FILES") + "\n")
633			} else {
634				content.WriteString(m.styles.render(m.styles.label, "Files:") + "\n")
635			}
636			for _, f := range r.Data.FilesTouched {
637				content.WriteString("  " + f + "\n")
638			}
639		}
640	
641		return strings.TrimRight(content.String(), "\n")
642	}

743	func indentLines(text, prefix string) string {

752	// wrapText wraps text to the given width, breaking at word boundaries.
753	// Existing newlines in the input are preserved.
754	func wrapText(text string, width int) string {
755		if width <= 0 {
756			return text
757		}
758		var result strings.Builder
759		for i, paragraph := range strings.Split(text, "\n") {
760			if i > 0 {
761				result.WriteByte('\n')
762			}
763			wrapParagraph(&result, paragraph, width)
764		}
765		return result.String()
766	}
767	
768	func wrapParagraph(b *strings.Builder, text string, width int) {
769		words := strings.Fields(text)
770		if len(words) == 0 {
771			return
772		}
773		lineLen := 0
774		for i, w := range words {
775			wLen := len(w)
776			if i == 0 {
777				b.WriteString(w)
778				lineLen = wLen
779				continue
780			}
781			if lineLen+1+wLen > width {
782				b.WriteByte('\n')
783				b.WriteString(w)
784				lineLen = wLen
785			} else {
786				b.WriteByte(' ')
787				b.WriteString(w)
788				lineLen += 1 + wLen
789			}
790		}
791	}

795	// columnLayout holds computed column widths for the search results table.
796	type columnLayout struct {
797		age    int

805	// computeColumns calculates column widths from terminal width.
806	func computeColumns(width int) columnLayout {
807		const (
808			ageWidth    = 10
809			idWidth     = 12
810			repoMin     = 10
811			authorWidth = 14
812			gaps        = 5 // spaces between columns
813		)
814	
815		remaining := width - ageWidth - idWidth - authorWidth - gaps
816		if remaining < 20 {
817			remaining = 20
818		}
819	
820		branchWidth := max(remaining*18/100, 8)
821		repoWidth := max(remaining*18/100, repoMin)
822		promptWidth := remaining - branchWidth - repoWidth
823		if promptWidth < 12 {
824			reclaim := 12 - promptWidth
825			repoWidth = max(repoWidth-reclaim, repoMin)
826			promptWidth = remaining - branchWidth - repoWidth
827		}
828	
829		return columnLayout{
830			age:    ageWidth,
831			id:     idWidth,
832			branch: branchWidth,
833			repo:   repoWidth,
834			prompt: promptWidth,
835			author: authorWidth,
836		}
837	}

- Wrapped `huh.ThemeDracula` in `huh.ThemeFunc` to satisfy the new `huh.Theme` interface.

- Instructed local dispatch generation to render repo headings as markdown links when a trusted URL exists.

- Moved specific interface-return allowances into `.golangci.yaml` and removed redundant per-line suppressions.
